title: Attio button
description: Soft-cornered product buttons: a near-black fill with a faint top light that brightens on hover, a white outline whose grey hairline darkens on hover, and a ghost nav pill. Small arrow buttons nudge their arrow right. All change over a slow 0.3s.
notes: works as a link (href) or as a real button (no href, e.g. a form submit)
